name: rateguard
description: RateGuard — Distributed API Rate-Limiting & Traffic Control Platform

scripts.build: npm run build:cpp && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:cpp: powershell -Command "Set-Location rate-limiter; & 'C:\MinGW\bin\g++.exe' -std=c++11 -O2 src/engine.cpp -o engine.exe -lws2_32; & 'C:\MinGW\bin\g++.exe' -std=c++11 -O2 tests/test_rate_limiter.cpp -o test_runner.exe -lws2_32"
scripts.test: npm run test:cpp && npm run test:backend

author: RateGuard Team
